title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, September 14-20
content: A marathon re-airing of the 10th season of the live-action A Solitary Gourmet series aired on TV Tokyo on Tuesday, September 15 at 6:20 p.m., and it earned a 4.5% rating. The Fortune Favors Lady Nikuko anime film aired on NHK Educational on Sunday, September 20 at 3:30 p.m. and it earned a 0.8% rating.

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Taihi Kimura
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Saturday that Taihi Kimura voices Noel, the third son of the Benfield family. The anime will air on TBS and other stations.
author: ANN

title: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Sequel Anime Announced
content: A new Dr. STONE sequel anime titled Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is officially in production. The project will continue the story after the conclusion of the TV anime , which premiered its series finale on June 25, 2026. The new anime will adapt “TERRAFORMING,” a sequel story included in Volume 27 of the original manga.
author: Anime Corner

title: Billy Bat Manga Wins Harvey Award
content: The Harvey Awards, which honor outstanding work in comics and sequential art, announced the winners for this year's awards on Friday at New York Comic Con . Naoki Urasawa and Takashi Nagasaki 's Billy Bat manga, released by Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint, won the award for Best Manga.
